title: EventBus re-registration after idempotent unregister contract

contract.duplicate_registration: Repeated registration of an equivalent callback remains idempotent and does not create a second listener entry
contract.unregister: Unregister removes the single registered callback
contract.post_unregister_registry: The listener registry is empty immediately after removal
contract.reregistration: A previously unregistered callback can be registered again successfully
contract.reregistration_registry: Re-registration creates exactly one listener entry
contract.delivery: The re-registered callback receives the emitted event exactly once
contract.registry_stability: The listener registry remains structurally consistent after re-registration and emit
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit continue to require the events permission
